New York: A Global Entry member flew into Philadelphia from Amsterdam and told CBP she'd bought a few thousand dollars of souvenirs. Officers already knew about a $183,818 Cartier bracelet and a $67,811 Cartier ring.

She declared only after officers said they knew. She'd also thrown away the boxes and receipts.

CBP seized both pieces and moved to revoke her Global Entry membership.
